Name: MailBoxGift
Author: shashwath123
Description:
[b]Description[/b] Mailbox Gifts is a quality-of-life mod that allows you to send presents to villagers directly from your farmhouse mailbox. It saves you from running all over Pelican Town to track people down by letting you mail gifts to any friend you share a close bond with. The mailed gifts are delivered overnight, and the resulting friendship points are applied to the villager the very next morning!
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the .zip file.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted 
[code]MailboxGifts[/code] folder directly into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mail Gifts:[/b] Interact with an empty farmhouse mailbox to open a custom directory of your friends, then select an item from your inventory to ship it.[/*]
[*][b]4-Heart Unlock:[/b] You must earn the right to mail! Villagers will only appear in your mailing list once you have reached at least 4 hearts with them.[/*]
[*][b]Native UI:[/b] Scroll through a beautifully integrated menu featuring villager portraits and their current heart levels.[/*]
[*][b]Authentic Friendship Math:[/b] The mod fully respects Stardew Valley's friendship system. It automatically checks the villager's tastes (Loved, Liked, Disliked, Hated) and correctly scales the friendship points based on the item's quality (Silver, Gold, Iridium) just like a hand-delivered gift.[/*]
[*][b]Immersive Delivery:[/b] Gifts take a day to ship in the mail! Items are removed from your inventory immediately, but the friendship points are applied the next morning when you wake up.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] (or newer)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API)[/*]
[*]No other framework mods are required![/*]
[/list]Future Ideas:
[*]💌 [b]Personal Messages[/b] – Add a message along with every gift. [/*]
[*]📬 [b]NPC Replies[/b] – Villagers can send letters and gifts back. [/*]
[*]🎁 [b]Care Packages[/b] – Send multiple gifts in one package. [/*]
[*]🎂 [b]Birthday Delivery[/b] – Special birthday gifts with unique reactions. [/*]
[*]❤️ [b]Gift History[/b] – Track gifts sent to each NPC. [/*]
[*]📝 [b]NPC Requests[/b] – Villagers can request specific items by mail. [/*]
[*]💍 [b]Spouse Mail[/b] – Receive special letters and gifts from your spouse. [/*]
[*]🧠 [b]Gift Memory[/b] – NPCs remember gifts you sent previously. [/*]
[*]📦 [b]Special Deliveries[/b] – Add urgent and premium delivery options. [/*]
[*]🧩 [b]Mod Compatibility[/b] – Support custom items and NPCs from other mods.
